name: hookreel
description: Interview-to-video pipeline for short vertical videos (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) for any brand with its own context profile: structured interview and project CLAUDE.md, fact gate, WTF Hook 999 story, reviewed script, then new custom motion design per video invented from the user's reference reels (one prototype scene approved first), beats timed on character-aligned spoken words, synthesised sound effects, loudness check, ElevenLabs voice with exact word times, a scored critique loop on stills, a scene-by-scene cached render and a 30 fps Remotion toolkit, plus /hookreel:produce for the rest of a video in one run; plus photo carousels from a source post, rendered and checked.
